repo.name: cudnn-frontend

detail.body:
Causal THD forward attention currently leaves all softmax exponent work on MUFU, including interior tiles with no causal-mask work. On SM100, use the existing mixed-exp2 implementation for 32 of each 128 columns on eligible BF16 D128-flavor interior tiles. Masked and diagonal tiles retain the existing MUFU path. This reduces complete context-parallel attention latency in the measured workload.

The extension is limited to nonpaged, unsplit causal THD without a sliding window, under the existing architecture gate. Dense causal, FP16 causal THD, D64, paged and split-KV behavior remain unchanged. There is no new API, knob, capability, allocation or kernel launch.

**Stacked on #1696** (`aae7a712`). That work-lookup commit is unchanged; this PR adds the interior-softmax optimization and its tests. The cumulative diff will shrink when the parent lands.

### Complete context-parallel measurements

B32 / S16384 / Hq32 / Hkv8 / D128, BF16 causal THD, 524,288 tokens, CP4/A2A. Each node uses four 148-SM B200 GPUs at default 1000 W with NV18 links. cuDNN 9.27.0.42, CUDA 13.2, CuTeDSL 4.8 cu13 and FA4 4.0.0b35.dev1+gbb25ba3. Warm eager timing includes forward, backward, helpers and communication through native TE C++, using the slowest rank. The candidate changes only the forward interior softmax; TE binaries, backward and communication are fixed.

| Independent node | Baseline FROST | Interior-exp2 FROST | FA4 | Paired candidate / baseline |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| A | 74.617 ms | 73.342 ms | 70.940 ms | -1.72% |
| B | 74.517 ms | 73.367 ms | 70.716 ms | -1.46% |

Each node has four balanced orders, 16 fresh four-rank process sets, 256 complete output/gradient checks and 48 telemetry/stability windows. Each process set uses three blocks of five warmups and 50 timed iterations. Candidate latency is lower in 4/4 paired orders on each node; the incremental saving is 1.46–1.72%. The optimized path still takes 3.34–3.78% longer than FA4. Percentages are medians of within-order paired ratios; nodes are not pooled.

These performance measurements retain their frozen experimental-package attribution. The public patch keeps the measured nonpaged kernel body, normalizes its static gate to bool and explicitly excludes paged inference. Exact public-package GPU qualification is reported below; complete-CP performance of the published package has not been remeasured, and no original benchmark-grid win rate is claimed.

### Validation

- Exact candidate on B200: **22 numerical / changed-input replay cases** and **one explicit unsupported-cga1 rejection case**, with zero skips. Independent CPU FP64 checks cover O and Stats, both causal alignments, MHA/GQA, token/head-major packed Stats, scaled inputs, zero-length replay and untouched output capacity.
- Six numerical cases additionally cover served D128-flavor widths `(72,72)`, `(120,120)`, `(96,80)`, `(80,96)`, `(128,64)` and `(64,128)`. These use the public unpacked-GQA contract and separate V/O element offsets; no capability is expanded.
- **memcheck, racecheck and synccheck** each pass both an exact-D128 packed case and a 96/80 unpacked case, with zero reported errors or hazards.
- **49 host gate checks** and **14 CPU template lowerings** cover architecture, dtype, cluster, head-flavor and paged controls. Other-architecture compilation is not GPU execution, and raw-template compilation is not public-graph admission.
- Default L0 collection selects one case; the rest are L1. Changed-file pre-commit checks pass. The existing native binding is reused with 108 C++/header inputs verified unchanged; this is a Python kernel/test change.

[First-node complete-CP evidence](https://sc.talos.nvidia.com/view/home/scratch.yanxu_libs/cudnn_frontend/.te-cp-20261012/results/te_frost_exp25_cp_v326_qualified.json) · [Independent-node repeat](https://sc.talos.nvidia.com/view/home/scratch.yanxu_libs/cudnn_frontend/.te-cp-20261012/results/te_frost_exp25_cp_v335_qualified.json) · [Exact candidate qualification](https://sc.talos.nvidia.com/view/home/scratch.yanxu_libs/cudnn_frontend/.te-cp-20261012/results/frost_exp25_public_v353_result.json).




<!-- te-cp-gpu-ci-followup-20261019 -->
GPU CI follow-up at head `41be3b1`: the aggregate pipeline reports success, but the SM107 SDPA lane is marked `allow_failure` and still fails `test_sdpa_fwd_cc107_decode_tile_envelope_pinned_L0[gpt_oss_d64_sink_swa]`. The assertion expects the D128 decode template while the native small-D route serves the prefill template. That lane reports 15,507 passing tests and one failure. Aggregate success therefore does not establish complete GPU CI coverage. Existing dependency, host/device performance, and merge holds remain; no merge is authorized by this result alone.

+        search = cutlass.Int32(1)
+        # batch_remap is sorted by decreasing Q length. Rounding length to
+        # tile count is monotone, so equal endpoint counts prove that EVERY
+        # batch has the same count, including unequal lengths in one bucket.
+        # All observations are current device metadata; no host promise.
+        if n_batch > cutlass.Int32(0):
+            first_b = cutlass.Int32(cu[remap0])
+            last_b = cutlass.Int32(cu[remap0 + n_batch - cutlass.Int32(1)])
+            first_s = cutlass.Int32(cu[cuq0 + first_b + cutlass.Int32(1)]) - cutlass.Int32(cu[cuq0 + first_b])
+            last_s = cutlass.Int32(cu[cuq0 + last_b + cutlass.Int32(1)]) - cutlass.Int32(cu[cuq0 + last_b])
+            first_cb = (first_s + cutlass.Int32(thd_token_tile_m - 1)) // cutlass.Int32(thd_token_tile_m)
+            last_cb = (last_s + cutlass.Int32(thd_token_tile_m - 1)) // cutlass.Int32(thd_token_tile_m)
+            if first_cb == last_cb:
+                search = cutlass.Int32(0)
+                if first_cb > cutlass.Int32(0):
+                    per_batch = first_cb * n_qh
+                    ordinal = u // per_batch
+                    if ordinal < n_batch:
+                        f_batch = cutlass.Int32(cu[remap0 + ordinal])
+                        found_cb = first_cb
+                        found_local = u % per_batch
+                        done = cutlass.Int32(1)
+        i = cutlass.Int32(0)
+        # Preserve longest-first remapping and the DEAD-unit sentinel. Empty
+        # batches consume zero work. No host knowledge of lengths is needed.
+        while (i < n_batch) & (done == cutlass.Int32(0)) & (search != cutlass.Int32(0)):
+            b = cutlass.Int32(cu[remap0 + i])
+            s_i = cutlass.Int32(cu[cuq0 + b + cutlass.Int32(1)]) - cutlass.Int32(cu[cuq0 + b])
+            cb = (s_i + cutlass.Int32(thd_token_tile_m - 1)) // cutlass.Int32(thd_token_tile_m)
+            units_b = cb * n_qh
+            if u < acc + units_b:
+                f_batch = b
+                found_cb = cb
+                found_local = u - acc
+                done = cutlass.Int32(1)
+            acc = acc + units_b
+            i = i + cutlass.Int32(1)
+        # Quotient/remainder decoding is needed only for the matching batch.
+        # cb is positive here; keep head/row zero for an unclaimed work unit.
+        if done != cutlass.Int32(0):
+            f_head = found_local // found_cb
+            f_qc = found_local % found_cb
+            if cutlass.const_expr(CFG.DTYPE_QKV in (2, 3) and CFG.TILE_K in (64, 128, 256)):
+                if cutlass.const_expr(CFG.SCHEDULER_POLICY == SCHED_LPT):
+                    f_head = found_local % n_qh
+                    f_qc = found_cb - cutlass.Int32(1) - found_local // n_qh
+                elif cutlass.const_expr(CFG.SCHEDULER_POLICY == SCHED_LPT_L2):
+                    group = cutlass.Int32(_packed_heads_per_kv if CFG.PACK_GQA else CFG.QH_PER_KH)
+                    f_head = (found_local // (found_cb * group)) * group + found_local % group
+                    f_qc = found_cb - cutlass.Int32(1) - (found_local // group) % found_cb
+        q_super = f_qc * cutlass.Int32(_q_supers_per_cluster) + cta_in_pair
+        return q_super, f_head, f_batch + split * n_batch
+
+    _thd_decode_impl = _thd_decode_bounded if bounded_thd_decode else _thd_decode

+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
+
+"""Causal THD interior softmax across changed inputs, masks and graph replay."""
+
+import itertools
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from frost_test_utils import requires_dsl
+
+B, S, H, D = 3, 2048, 4, 128
+CAP = B * S
+
+
+def _make_case(kv_heads, scale, seed, qlens, klens, d_qk=D, d_v=D):
+    gen = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(seed)
+    cpu = [
+        (torch.randn(CAP, heads, d_qk if i < 2 else d_v, generator=gen) * (scale if i < 2 else 0.5)).bfloat16()
+        for i, heads in enumerate((H, kv_heads, kv_heads))
+    ]
+    cuq, cuk = [0], [0]
+    for nq, nk in zip(qlens, klens):
+        cuq.append(cuq[-1] + nq)
+        cuk.append(cuk[-1] + nk)
+    values = {n: t.cuda() for n, t in zip(("q", "k", "v"), cpu)}
+    values.update(
+        sq=torch.tensor(qlens, device="cuda", dtype=torch.int32).view(B, 1, 1, 1),
+        sk=torch.tensor(klens, device="cuda", dtype=torch.int32).view(B, 1, 1, 1),
+        rq=(torch.tensor(cuq, device="cuda", dtype=torch.int64) * H * d_qk).view(B + 1, 1, 1, 1),
+        rk=(torch.tensor(cuk, device="cuda", dtype=torch.int64) * kv_heads * d_qk).view(B + 1, 1, 1, 1),
+    )
+    values["rv"] = values["rk"] // d_qk * d_v
+    values["ro"] = values["rq"] // d_qk * d_v
+    return values, (cpu, cuq, cuk)
+
+
+def _reference(host, bottom_right):
+    (q, k, v), cuq, cuk = host
+    outputs, stats = [], []
+    for i in range(B):
+        nq, nk = cuq[i + 1] - cuq[i], cuk[i + 1] - cuk[i]
+        if not nq:
+            continue
+        qr, kr, vr = [x.double().transpose(0, 1) for x in (q[cuq[i] : cuq[i + 1]], k[cuk[i] : cuk[i + 1]], v[cuk[i] : cuk[i + 1]])]
+        repeat = H // k.shape[1]
+        scores = qr @ kr.repeat_interleave(repeat, 0).transpose(-1, -2) * q.shape[-1] ** -0.5
+        keep = torch.arange(nk)[None, :] <= torch.arange(nq)[:, None] + (nk - nq if bottom_right else 0)
+        scores.masked_fill_(~keep, -torch.inf)
+        probs = scores.softmax(-1)
+        probs = torch.where(keep.any(-1)[None, :, None], probs, torch.zeros_like(probs))
+        outputs.append((probs @ vr.repeat_interleave(repeat, 0)).transpose(0, 1))
+        stats.append(scores.logsumexp(-1).transpose(0, 1))
+    return torch.cat(outputs), torch.cat(stats)
+
+
+def _build_graph(values, kv_heads, bottom_right, layout, cta_mma=2):
+    import cudnn
+
+    d_qk, d_v = values["q"].shape[-1], values["v"].shape[-1]
+    io = cudnn.data_type.BFLOAT16
+    g = cudnn.pygraph(io_data_type=io, intermediate_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT, compute_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT)
+    nodes = {}
+    for name, heads in [("q", H), ("k", kv_heads), ("v", kv_heads)]:
+        dim = values[name].shape[-1]
+        nodes[name] = g.tensor(dim=[B, heads, S, dim], stride=[S * heads * dim, dim, heads * dim, 1], data_type=io, name=name)
+    for name in ("sq", "sk", "rq", "rk", "rv", "ro"):
+        nodes[name] = g.tensor_like(values[name], name=name)
+    nodes["q"].set_ragged_offset(nodes["rq"])
+    nodes["k"].set_ragged_offset(nodes["rk"])
+    nodes["v"].set_ragged_offset(nodes["rv"])
+    mask = dict(use_causal_mask_bottom_right=True) if bottom_right else dict(use_causal_mask=True)
+    o, stats = g.sdpa(
+        q=nodes["q"],
+        k=nodes["k"],
+        v=nodes["v"],
+        generate_stats=True,
+        attn_scale=d_qk**-0.5,
+        use_padding_mask=True,
+        seq_len_q=nodes["sq"],
+        seq_len_kv=nodes["sk"],
+        **mask,
+    )
+    o.set_output(True).set_dim([B, H, S, d_v]).set_stride([S * H * d_v, d_v, H * d_v, 1]).set_ragged_offset(nodes["ro"])
+    factor = 1 if layout == "head_major" else H

+    stats.set_output(True).set_data_type(cudnn.data_type.FLOAT).set_dim([B, H, S, 1])
+    stats.set_stride([H * CAP, CAP, 1, 1] if layout == "head_major" else [S * H, 1, H, 1]).set_ragged_offset(nodes["rs"])

+    names = [g.get_plan_name_at_index(i) for i in range(len(g.plans))]
+    index = next((i for i, name in enumerate(names) if name.split("[")[0] == "sdpa_fwd_prefill_sm100"), None)
+    assert index is not None, names
+    engine, knobs = g.get_engine_and_knobs_at_index(index)
+    knobs.update(

+            cudnn.knob_type.SPLIT_KV: 1,

+    g.select_plan(len(g.plans) - 1)

+    for name, heads in [("q", H), ("k", kv_heads), ("v", kv_heads), ("o", H)]:
+        dim = values[name].shape[-1]
+        vp[nodes[name]] = values[name].as_strided((B, heads, S, dim), (S * heads * dim, dim, heads * dim, 1))

+    return g, vp, workspace

+
+def _check(values, expected, layout):
+    want_o, want_s = expected
+    live = len(want_o)
+    got_s = values["stats"].T if layout == "head_major" else values["stats"]
+    for role, got, want, tol in [("o", values["o"][:live], want_o, 0.015), ("stats", got_s[:live], want_s, 1e-4)]:
+        actual = got.double().cpu()
+        torch.testing.assert_close(actual, want, atol=tol, rtol=tol)
+        assert torch.equal(torch.isneginf(actual), torch.isneginf(want))
+        finite = torch.isfinite(want)
+        rms = ((actual[finite] - want[finite]).square().sum() / want[finite].square().sum().clamp_min(1e-20)).sqrt().item()
+        assert rms < (0.02 if role == "o" else 1e-4)
+
+    assert torch.equal(values["o"][live:], torch.full_like(values["o"][live:], 2048.0))
+    assert torch.equal(got_s[live:], torch.full_like(got_s[live:], 2048.0))

+def _run_causal_thd_interior_replay(bottom_right, kv_heads, layout, scale, d_qk=D, d_v=D):
+    major, minor = torch.cuda.get_device_capability()
+    if major != 10 or minor >= 7:

+    values, host = _make_case(kv_heads, scale, 320, (1537, 513, 0), (1025, 1793, 0), d_qk, d_v)
+    g, vp, workspace = _build_graph(values, kv_heads, bottom_right, layout)
+    stream = torch.cuda.Stream()
+    stream.wait_stream(torch.cuda.current_stream())
+    previous_mode = torch.cuda.get_sync_debug_mode()
+    try:
+        torch.cuda.set_sync_debug_mode("error")

+            g.execute(vp, workspace)
+    finally:
+        torch.cuda.set_sync_debug_mode(previous_mode)
+    torch.cuda.current_stream().wait_stream(stream)
+    _check(values, _reference(host, bottom_right), layout)
+    stream.wait_stream(torch.cuda.current_stream())

+    for name, buf, heads in (("q", q, hq), ("k", k, hkv), ("v", v, hkv)):

Reviewed `41be3b14e751` against base `a7269d7607db`.

The interior-only exp2 extension looks sound. The static gates preserve the existing architecture/dtype/layout scope, while the two masked segments continue using the original MUFU path. I found no actionable defect. Independent parent/head measurements show a forward-plus-Stats improvement in the two local workloads tested; they do not establish complete context-parallel latency.

Validation: Reviewed the three-file increment over aae7a712 and reused my completed #1696 review for the unchanged work-lookup parent. Checked both softmax chunks, mask-segment selection, the existing emulation range/error contract, public admission and unchanged synchronization/launch ordering. Exact-head SM100 testing with released CuTeDSL 4.7: 72 passed, zero skips. This comprises 22 numerical/changed-input replay cases, one explicit unsupported-cga1 rejection, and 49 host gate checks. The numerical cases compare complete O/Stats against CPU FP64, including causal alignments, MHA/GQA, packed Stats layouts, unequal head widths, zero-length replay and untouched capacity. Host architecture checks are not native tests of those architectures. Racecheck passed both a packed D128 case and an unpacked D96/V80 case: two tests, zero reported hazards/errors/warnings. Source and binding provenance checks passed. A separate clean local merge with current develop a7269d76 passed 51 selected checks: both representative numerical/replay cases and the 49 host checks. The newer bias/kv-mask body explicitly excludes THD, so this extension does not activate that separate path. Fresh-process parent/head/head/parent comparison on an SM100 engineering device with 148 SMs, BF16 causal THD, B2/Hq8/Hkv2/D128: full forward-plus-Stats graph latency was 39.21–39.23 to 37.10–37.12 microseconds at S1024, and 169.79–170.45 to 155.63–156.34 microseconds at S4096 (about 5.4% and 8.3% lower). CPU enqueue medians overlapped at approximately 17–18 microseconds, and workspace stayed at 896 bytes. Complete CPU-FP64 checks passed before timing and after poisoned replay in every process. Observed SM/memory clocks were unchanged before/after; clocks were not modified.

Limitations: Native validation covers SM100 engineering devices, not qualified production B200 or native SM103/SM107. I did not independently reproduce the author's multi-node TE/CP experiments; local forward timing excludes backward and communication. Style passed on this head. The failing merge-requirements check reports an unset milestone; the intended release still needs an owner/maintainer assignment. Broader GPU CI remains separate from the completed local review.
